completions.instruction: List five examples of data structures.
completions.response:
Here are five common examples of data structures:

1. Array - A collection of elements identified by an index or key. Each element can be accessed directly using its index.

2. Linked List - A linear collection of data elements, called nodes, where each node points to the next node in the sequence. 

3. Stack - A Last-In-First-Out (LIFO) abstract data type and data structure. Elements are added and removed from the "top" of the stack.

4. Queue - A First-In-First-Out (FIFO) abstract data type and data structure. Elements are added at the rear and removed from the front.

5. Tree - A hierarchical data structure consisting of nodes connected by edges. It has a root node with no parent and other nodes have one parent. Trees are used to represent branching structures.
